modules.title: Disable central CLI defaults
modules.tier_rationale: a default route can silently bill/expose a personal subscription account (AUD-009) — credential/account boundary
acceptance: WHEN any central or background workload requests a route, THE SYSTEM SHALL never select the user-subscription CLI unless the request carries the explicit endpoint-interactive development profile.
WHEN the endpoint-interactive profile is absent, THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve defaults exclusively to approved connector routes.

modules.title: humanos-ai-contracts v1
modules.tier_rationale: the contract of record every governed AI call rides; every dependent module binds to it
acceptance: WHEN the shared client, runtime gateway and ai-execution-service exchange requests, THE SYSTEM SHALL pass versioned contract fixtures including negative cases (REM-002 acceptance).
WHEN a pure service-to-service request arrives, THE SYSTEM SHALL reconcile a service identity with audience and purpose claims before honouring a caller-supplied tenant (AUD-016).
WHEN a field the contract requires is absent, THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse the request with the canonical error taxonomy, never default it.

modules.title: Claude CLI process safety
modules.tier_rationale: concrete security/reliability defect — path hijack, inherited env, stderr deadlock, ineffective timeout (AUD-011)
acceptance: WHEN a CLI process hangs, THE SYSTEM SHALL terminate the whole process tree within the timeout budget with no stderr deadlock.

WHEN the CLI is resolved, THE SYSTEM SHALL execute only a signed executable from an approved path with a clean environment and approved working directory, and SHALL NOT reach outside the approved root.

modules.title: Endpoint AI Runtime Broker
modules.tier_rationale: moves subscription/local-runtime execution to the managed endpoint boundary; central OAuth access is a hard boundary (T04)
acceptance: WHEN any central component needs endpoint execution, THE SYSTEM SHALL delegate to the broker and SHALL NOT access user-local OAuth or credentials.
WHEN the broker executes, THE SYSTEM SHALL report health/action-required states and return canonical contract results.

modules.title: Provider-scoped credential resolution
modules.tier_rationale: silent tenant-to-platform account/data-route switch is a privacy/billing incident (AUD-015)
acceptance: WHEN the tenant credential service is unavailable, THE SYSTEM SHALL fail per policy and SHALL NOT silently switch to a platform key, account, provider or data route.
WHEN credentials rotate, THE SYSTEM SHALL pass rotation, outage, tenant and identity tests without cross-tenant leakage.

modules.title: Evidence-object persistence (no raw prompts)
modules.tier_rationale: writes the record of record for AI evidence; raw prompt/output persistence is incompatible with retention/employee rights (AUD-018)
acceptance: WHEN a new execution is persisted, THE SYSTEM SHALL store no mandatory raw input/output text fields — only classified object references and minimised metadata.
WHEN retention, correction, deletion or hold events occur, THE SYSTEM SHALL propagate them across the evidence lineage and pass the privacy/DR test set.

modules.title: Exact model-deployment registry
modules.tier_rationale: route identity is the substrate of qualification and audit; family/alias-only identity voids both (T07)
acceptance: WHEN a route becomes active, THE SYSTEM SHALL represent it by an exact model deployment and SHALL NOT accept a family/alias-only representation.
WHEN a deployment alias cannot be resolved to an exact identity, THE SYSTEM SHALL shorten or disable its qualification (AUD-020).

modules.title: Qualification lifecycle & hard gate
modules.tier_rationale: decides which model configurations may execute employee-affecting work; an unqualified route is a policy breach (T08)
acceptance: WHEN a route candidate lacks a current qualification for the task×effort cell, THE SYSTEM SHALL exclude it before selection (negative tests).
WHEN a qualification expires, THE SYSTEM SHALL stop selecting the configuration until requalified.
WHILE tool calling is prompt-simulated (AUD-012), THE SYSTEM SHALL never qualify that mode for production tool-use cells.

modules.title: Eligibility router & canonical fallback
modules.tier_rationale: the routing decision is the policy enforcement point for every AI call; fallback semantics carry employee-rights consequences (T09)
acceptance: WHEN candidates are filtered, THE SYSTEM SHALL record every rejected candidate's reason auditably, and cost SHALL NOT make an ineligible route eligible.
WHEN no eligible route exists, THE SYSTEM SHALL resolve to the canonical no-route/human-review/no-AI terminal — never a silent material route change.
WHEN AI is unavailable, THE SYSTEM SHALL never convert that into employee failure (journey tests).

modules.title: Complete inference lineage
modules.tier_rationale: material AI-assisted domain records are records of record; incomplete lineage breaks audit and review rights (T10)
acceptance: WHEN a material AI-assisted domain record is written, THE SYSTEM SHALL attach complete lineage — 100% coverage in the audit read-model (REM-011).

modules.title: Monorepo provider cutover
modules.tier_rationale: direct provider SDK/HTTP use outside the choke point voids every gateway control (T01)
acceptance: WHEN the dependency scan runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL show no service outside approved connector modules importing provider config/SDK or sending provider HTTP requests.

modules.title: Codex read-only review wrapper
modules.tier_rationale: development tooling with permission boundaries; performs no record-of-record mutation itself — M14 is the merge authority
acceptance: WHEN Codex reviews plan/diff/test evidence, THE SYSTEM SHALL prevent any worktree modification or merge action (permission tests).
WHEN findings are produced, THE SYSTEM SHALL capture the exact model identity and structured finding schema; injection tests pass.

modules.title: Fable & Opus development task profiles
modules.tier_rationale: profile/policy configuration for dev routing; enforcement authorities are M08/M14
acceptance: WHEN the Fable profile executes, THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse coding-write capabilities; WHEN the Opus profile executes, THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse self-review/merge capabilities (policy tests).

modules.title: CI + named-human merge gate
modules.tier_rationale: protected-branch merge is an irreversible governance act; an AI-only merge is the exact failure T11 forbids
acceptance: WHEN a merge to a protected branch is attempted, THE SYSTEM SHALL require deterministic CI, resolved Codex blockers/majors and a named human approval — no AI-only merge (repository control test).

modules.title: Provider connectors (native + constrained compatible)
modules.tier_rationale: connectors execute under M09's eligibility gates; floor anchor for provider correctness
acceptance: WHEN a connector lacks a probed capability, THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the feature before execution (conformance).
WHEN provider errors occur, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep sensitive provider bodies out of logs and record exact route/features.

modules.title: Provider health, budgets & circuit breaking
modules.tier_rationale: operational signal source consumed by the router; no direct record mutation
acceptance: WHEN a route is unhealthy or over budget, THE SYSTEM SHALL exclude it without weakening any policy guarantee (chaos/load tests).

modules.title: Model catalogue endpoint security
modules.tier_rationale: information-disclosure control on the registry surface
acceptance: WHEN an unauthenticated caller queries the catalogue, THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT enumerate internal providers, prices or routes (API security test).

modules.title: Durable audit ledger & quality feedback
modules.tier_rationale: durability layer under M10's lineage; loses no mandatory audit events
acceptance: WHEN the ledger is unavailable, THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT lose mandatory audit/quality events (outbox/reconciliation tests).

modules.title: Qualification corpus & initial runs
modules.tier_rationale: produces signed evaluation artefacts; the enforcement authority remains M08
acceptance: WHEN qualification runs complete, THE SYSTEM SHALL produce signed task×effort profiles with limitations, and SHALL NOT emit a global model approval.

modules.title: Stage 12A assurance execution
modules.tier_rationale: the hardening gate of record before any employee pilot (T13)
acceptance: WHEN the gate is convened, THE SYSTEM SHALL present per-track evidence rows mapped to the Stage 12A gate sheet; PASS or RESTRICT is a human decision this module cannot make (OI-03).

modules.title: Standalone router decision spike
modules.tier_rationale: a decision spike producing an ADR; no production operation performed
acceptance: WHEN the CTO decision is recorded, THE SYSTEM SHALL either close this module as decision-evidence-only or open a build change-proposal via plan-change.

modules.title: Pilot protocol readiness
modules.tier_rationale: a real employee pilot bears directly on employee rights; running it early is the exact harm T13 fences
acceptance: WHILE the Stage 12A gate has not passed or restricted, THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT start any real employee pilot.
WHEN the pilot runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL uphold participant rights (inspect/correct/dispute/appeal) and never let AI directly decide dismissal, pay, promotion, probation or discipline.

planningQaChecks.title: Every module has a valid tier (0/1/2)
Every module has a valid status
Bound review evidence matches the current target
Every module records a tier rationale
Tier-0 verified modules carry a recorded dual-review verdict (structural only)
Tier-0 review is cross-family independent (reviewer family != implementer family)
Tier-0 records two distinct reviewer families (true dual review)
Reviews were performed by the planned reviewer family (no silent substitution)
Every module 'satisfies' a declared truth (no dangling references)
Dependencies resolve, are acyclic, and gate on verified
Every depends_on interface resolves to the target module's declared provides
Loose coupling (no God Object, no interface-less dependency)
No compliance obligations declared (G3 not applicable)
planningQaChecks.detail: this plan declares no `compliance` tags — G3 is a no-op, as for most non-regulated projects
